story: Rooted in legacy. Driven by contemporary possibilities.
Kalaayana Studios is a creative studio founded by artists Vishal Kavatekar and Vinay Kumar S., built on a foundation of artistic tradition, craftsmanship, and contemporary thinking.

The studio carries forward the sculptural legacy of Shilpi K. Narayana Rao, a traditional sculptor whose dedication and contribution to temple art and monumental sculpture continue to inspire its practice.

Bringing together generations of artistic knowledge, fine arts education, and contemporary production techniques, Kalaayana Studios works across sculpture, murals, installations, restoration, and customised commissions.
We believe in preserving the essence of traditional craftsmanship while exploring new materials, techniques, and possibilities.
For us, continuing a legacy is not simply about preserving the past, but keeping its spirit alive through new expressions.
